title: Non-canonical Oscillator Representations of Orthogonal Lie Algebras and Pfaffian Varieties
summary: Associated varieties are fundamental geometric invariants in the study of infinite-dimensional representations of semisimple Lie algebras. Luo and Xu (2013) constructed a large family of infinite-dimensional irreducible representations of orthogonal Lie algebras by applying Fourier transforms to the natural oscillator representations. In this paper, we prove that the associated varieties of these irreducible representations are isomorphic to explicitly described coordinate linear sections of Pfaffian varieties.
